summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Academic Researchers, a program giving up to 100,000 researchers at selected academic institutions free access to its frontier models (including the GPT-5.6 family), expanded tools, and larger context windows.

mechanisms.reason: Free access rollout to up to 100,000 researchers plus collaborators expands the population issuing inference requests to OpenAI's models.
mechanisms.quote: We’re introducing ChatGPT for Academic Researchers, a program that will give 100,000 researchers at selected academic institutions free access to our frontier models.

mechanisms.reason: Participants get larger context windows and higher usage limits, increasing per-session memory and cache demand.
mechanisms.quote: They will also have expanded deep research, higher usage limits, and larger context windows.

practices.reason: Named benchmarks (FrontierMath Tier 4, GeneBench Pro) describe how the lab measures scientific reasoning capability but no reproducible methodology is given.
practices.quote: On GeneBench Pro, which evaluates complex biological data analysis and scientific reasoning, GPT‑5.6 Sol Pro solves 31.5% of tasks.
